description: This file defines a final class GatewayServiceResolver that performs DNS service discovery using NetService. It resolves host and port information for Bonjour services, providing a callback upon resolution or failure.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A resolver for Bonjour services using NetService, handling asynchronous resolution and callback upon success or failure.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with service name, type, domain, and a completion handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service resolution with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when the service address is resolved; processes host and port information.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when service resolution fails.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the resolution process, stops the service, and calls the completion handler.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static method to normalize raw hostnames.
